# gcloud

Google Cloud DNS record helpers built on `gcloud dns record-sets transaction`.

---

## `gcloud_dns_add_record`

Add a DNS record to a Cloud DNS managed zone, wrapped in a single transaction.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Mutates live DNS for the whole zone.

**Usage**

```sh
gcloud_dns_add_record [ip] [domain] [zone]
```

**Examples**

```sh
IP=1.2.3.4 gcloud_dns_add_record
gcloud_dns_add_record 1.2.3.4 api.example.com my-zone
```

**Requires** `gcloud`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/gcloud.sh:48`](../../modules/common/gcloud.sh#L48)

**See also** `gcloud_dns_remove_record`

---

## `gcloud_dns_remove_record`

Remove a DNS record from a Cloud DNS managed zone, wrapped in a single transaction.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes a live DNS record. Confirms first.

**Usage**

```sh
gcloud_dns_remove_record [ip] [domain] [zone]
```

**Examples**

```sh
IP=1.2.3.4 gcloud_dns_remove_record
gcloud_dns_remove_record 1.2.3.4 api.example.com my-zone
```

**Requires** `gcloud`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/gcloud.sh:73`](../../modules/common/gcloud.sh#L73)

**See also** `gcloud_dns_add_record`
